title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 5.47 (versions follow prime numbers; 547 after 541): the two readers that were left. To a question she answered the address of a file of Windows: a book of the disk holds an address in her house, not lines, and two of her readers (the book her luck picks, and her theme's book) still opened it as text, after three were cured in 5.09. All five now use one rule. Seen in a hidden copy with her real ways: six phrases with no path and no byte that is not text. What she answers from her books still has little to do with the question. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.47: los dos lectores que faltaban. Prototipo de investigación.
